items.title: Google Answers Questions About Search Console's Branded Queries Filter
items.summary: Google has addressed user queries regarding the new branded queries filter in Search Console, now expanded to all eligible sites and powered by AI classification. While useful for isolating brand performance, it may occasionally mislabel queries. This tool aids in precise SEO analysis amid AI changes.

items.title: Your Top SEO & AI Search News of the Week from #SEOFOMO - March 15, 2026
items.summary: Aleyda Solis curates the week's key SEO and AI search developments, including Google's Search Console branded queries expansion, insights on AI linking from Google execs, and technical SEO for AI crawlers. Other highlights cover digital PR's rise due to AI citations and e-commerce shifts from organic to product grids. Essential reading for staying ahead in AEO/GEO evolution.

items.title: Open-Sourced Tool Optimizes Websites for AI Search Engines: geo-seo-claude
items.summary: A new open-source tool called geo-seo-claude performs full GEO audits, analyzes schema for LLMs, and generates reports for AI search visibility on ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude. It uses parallel subagents for quick 60-second snapshots and structured data optimization. Ideal for SEOs adapting to AI search changes.

items.title: Anthropic Ran Entire Marketing with One Person Using AI Tools
items.summary: Anthropic's non-technical growth lead single-handedly managed paid search, social, SEO, and email using AI like Claude for ad optimization and automation. Ad creation time dropped from 2 hours to 15 minutes, boosting output 10x with 41% above-average conversions. Exemplifies AI's transformative role in content marketing efficiency.

items.title: Rise of AI-Generated 'Copycat' Books Stirs Outrage in Publishing
items.summary: AI-generated books mimicking successful human-authored works are flooding platforms like Amazon, appearing alongside bestsellers and prompting outrage from authors. This trend raises serious questions about marketplace integrity and the expanding role of AI in content creation. Concerns mount that profit-driven algorithms could undermine the quality of reading materials.

items.title: BookTok Headlines: Rejecting Third-Person Prose and Algorithm-Driven Publishing
items.summary: BookTok has rejected third-person prose, causing panic among publishers, while algorithms increasingly determine what gets published. With 59 million readers affirming romance's popularity, publishers are even incorporating BookTok trends into book covers. This reflects TikTok's literary community's profound influence on the industry.

items.title: Controversy Over AI Bans on Novel Covers at Comitia Self-Publishing Event
items.summary: Rules at Comitia prohibiting AI-generated works as main content and AI images for novel covers/illustrations have sparked debate. Critics contend that covers and illustrations aren't the 'subject' of novels, shifting focus from AI use to rule interpretation. This highlights tensions in self-publishing over AI integration.

items.title: Official BookTok Chart Set to Launch in the UK
items.summary: An official BookTok chart will debut later this year in the UK, ranking the top 20 monthly titles using verified sales data and TikTok engagement. Partnering NielsenIQ BookData and Media Control prioritize sales in their algorithm, building on a German trial. BookTok boosts sales in romance, fantasy, and romantasy by authors like Sarah J Maas for younger audiences.

items.title: Freya India: Conservative Christian 'Anti-Woke Voice' of Gen Z Women
items.summary: Freya India, labeled the 'anti-woke voice of Gen Z women' by the Sunday Times, is a conservative Christian writer addressing young women's struggles through traditional perspectives. Her book review underscores her rising influence in publishing amid cultural debates. The work promotes non-woke messaging in contemporary storytelling.

items.title: Publishing Ethics Clash with AI Book Flood on Kindle
items.summary: A surge of AI-generated books on Kindle is clashing with publishing ethics, with undercounted volumes challenging industry standards. Analysts highlight the flood's scale, even by conservative estimates, impacting content quality and authenticity. This development pressures traditional publishing practices.

items.title: Rachel Zegler Addresses 'Snow White' Casting Backlash and Refuses to 'Assimilate'
items.summary: Rachel Zegler, star of Disney's live-action Snow White remake, responded to backlash over the film's perceived 'woke' changes, her casting as a Latina actress, and her political tweets amid the movie's $170 million box office loss. She described the criticism as confusing and vowed not to assimilate for others' comfort in a recent interview. The controversy highlights ongoing audience rejection of the remake's alterations.

items.title: Woke 'The Bride!' Flops at Box Office, Outperformed by Family Films
items.summary: Maggie Gyllenhaal's 'The Bride!', a feminist take on Bride of Frankenstein emphasizing themes of misogyny and consent, earned only $7.26 million in its opening weekend against projections of $16-18 million. Audiences and critics panned its preachy messaging, resulting in a C+ CinemaScore and underperformance compared to Disney's 'Hoppers' and 'Scream 7'. The $90 million production underscores challenges for ideologically driven films.

items.title: Oscars 2026: 'One Battle After Another' Wins Best Picture, Michael B. Jordan Takes Best Actor
items.summary: At the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 'One Battle After Another' claimed Best Picture, Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for 'Sinners', and Jessie Buckley secured Best Actress. KPop Demon Hunters made history with a win for Best Original Song 'Golden' after a broadcast cut-off. The ceremony featured notable speeches and tributes amid recent industry shifts.

items.title: Variety Reports on Rachel Zegler's Response to Snow White Backlash
items.summary: Variety shared details of Rachel Zegler's interview where she called the backlash to her Snow White casting 'really confusing' and affirmed she refuses to assimilate. The post links to coverage of audience criticism tied to the film's woke elements and poor performance. It sparked discussions on Disney's remake controversies.

items.title: Daily Mail: Zegler Vows No Assimilation After Woke Snow White Box Office Disaster
items.summary: Daily Mail posted about Rachel Zegler's vow not to assimilate following backlash to Disney's Snow White reboot, which suffered a humiliating flop. The article highlights criticism of the film's changes and her comments. Users engaged with the ongoing debate over the remake.

items.title: Hollywood's Woke Mind Virus Leads to Snow White Flop and Industry Collapse
items.summary: User @NewEinHara argues the entertainment industry's prioritization of woke ideology over entertainment caused Disney's Snow White to lose $170M and 2025's box office dud. Cites reports on flops, DEI retreat, and calls for a reset to profit-focused content. References Elon Musk's 'woke mind virus' concept amid audience withdrawal.

items.title: What Small Business Owners Are Quietly Building with AI
items.summary: Small business owners are creating custom AI solutions like a dentist's AI receptionist that handles calls, bookings, and reminders, saving $4k per month. A food truck operator uses AI for demand prediction based on weather and sales data, cutting food waste by 40%. Other examples include AI photo editing for photographers and churn predictors for gyms, showing non-technical users gaining competitive edges through practical AI applications.

items.title: LinkedIn Launches AI-Powered Premium All-In-One Tool for Small Businesses
items.summary: LinkedIn has introduced an AI-enhanced Premium All-In-One dashboard tailored for SMBs, integrating sales, marketing, and hiring functions. This platform aims to drive growth by streamlining operations with AI insights. Shared by U.S. Chamber of Commerce highlighting its value for small business expansion.

items.title: Best AI Tools for Small Business in 2025
items.summary: This guide categorizes effective AI tools for small businesses, covering content creation, customer support, marketing, and more. It emphasizes tools that deliver tangible benefits while addressing real-world challenges like implementation costs and performance. Helps SMBs select practical AI solutions that enhance operations without unnecessary complexity.

items.title: 6 AI Business Models That Will Dominate in 2026
items.summary: The article outlines six emerging AI business models poised to lead in 2026, shifting focus from hype-driven chatbots to value-adding applications. It spotlights new tools and strategies that businesses should prioritize for real impact. Encourages adoption of proven AI innovations for competitive advantage.
